bluf: The Guardian reported Russian attacks on Ukraine’s energy grid, with blackouts and water shortages in Kyiv; BBC News World reported damage to Ukraine’s power network and nine people wounded ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi. France 24 reported at least 30 people were reportedly killed in an attack on a market in Yemen’s Taiz province, with responsibility disputed.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that SonicWall released security updates for seven SonicOS vulnerabilities, including an SSL-VPN authentication-bypass flaw exploited in attacks.

items.text: The Guardian reported that Moscow used 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles against electricity substations and a bridge over the Dnipro; an overnight attack on Ukraine’s energy grid was followed by blackouts and water shortages in Kyiv.
BBC News World reported that Russian strikes wounded nine people and damaged Ukraine’s power network ahead of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

France 24 reported that at least 30 people were reportedly killed in an attack on a market in Yemen’s Taiz province. Houthi rebels blamed Saudi airstrikes, while government forces and local authorities disputed that account and accused the Houthis of indiscriminate fire.
